g.text: Product Management: The system manages a catalog of products, each with a price and available quantity.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Inventory Management: The system tracks the quantity of each item and prevents dispensing if out of stock.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Payment Handling: The system accepts coins and notes, tracks total payment, and returns change if necessary.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: State Management: The system uses the State design pattern to manage its operational states (Idle, Ready, Dispense, ReturnChange).

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: User Interaction: Users can select products, insert coins/notes, and receive products and change.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Extensibility: Easy to add new item types, payment methods, or states.
